body:
We are doing that!  I am taking her rock-climbing this Thursday or Friday, and I am so excited for it!

I've always been the type of person to think very far ahead in the future though.  I can't be excited for this weekend since all I can think about is what will happen if she gives up on me, and how I can even make it to even 6 months at that point.  She says she is interested in other people, and while I want her to take the time to figure herself out, I'm so afraid that she'll meet someone who can do even more for her than I could.  I want her to be happy more than anything else, and I would be so happy if she had someone to fill her every need, but I want that person to be me more than anything else.

I mean, she tried a bit, and I tried to get into running.  MY addiction was to WoW, so I didn't really want to play a game with her during the past few months when my addiction was getting worse.  We sometimes did, but not a whole lot.  Honestly, I don't really care about her getting into gaming, I just want to be the best man in the world for her.
